newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ARES-SERONO SEES GOOD H2 PERFORMANCE.
newsitem.headline: ARES-SERONO SEES GOOD H2 PERFORMANCE.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals group Ares-Serono, a leader in infertility treatment, said its was very pleased with its first half performance and expected this to continue in the second half of the year.
"We are very pleased with our performance in the first half of 1997," Ares-Serono's chief executive Ernesto Bertarelli said in a statement.
"We expect this performance to continue in the second half of the year," he added.
Ares-Serono reported a 99.5 percent rise in its first half net profit to $41.1 million with operating income up 69.0 percent to $74.4 million.
First-half sales rose 16.4 percent to $437.6 million.

Bertarelli said the first half result reflected the strong contribution from the U.S. market, where the highly purified urine-derived FSH Metrodin HP/Fertinex and Serostim have been successfully launched, as well as the continued success of Metrodin HP and Gonal-F in Europe.
